page_title: BOU 3-0 BHA | Bournemouth v Brighton 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van Hecke J. P. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
90+4' The game is interrupted now, Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+2' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dominic Sadi (Bournemouth) replacing Justin Kluivert.
90+1' Substitution. James Hill (Bournemouth) in, Marcos Senesi out.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The corner from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is cleared away by the defence.

90' He should have scored! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Corner kick. Bournemouth will have an opportunity.
88' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Joao Pedro and he is replaced by Carlos Baleba (Brighton).

87' 3 - 0 Goal! Ryan Christie displays great vision and sends a pass to Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 3:0.
86' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
85' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. Bournemouth earn a corner.
84' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
84' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

82' Valentin Barco (Brighton) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) replaces Alex Scott.
76' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
75' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
75' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
74' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Igor is replaced by Adam Webster (Brighton).
74' The substitution is prepared. Joel Veltman (Brighton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Odeluga Offiah.
74' Joao Pedro (Brighton) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates. Brighton win a corner.
73' Julio Enciso (Brighton) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
70' Julio Enciso (Brighton) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
69' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles over the bar.
67' Here is a change. Enes Unal is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Ryan Christie (Bournemouth).
66' We are about to witness a subsitution. Julio Enciso (Brighton) for Simon Adingra.
66' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Valentin Barco (Brighton) is given a yellow card.
61' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Joao Pedro (Brighton) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
59' Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to Billy Gilmour (Brighton) for his blatant foul.

59' Valentin Barco (Brighton) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brighton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

58' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
57' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) has tested the patience of referee Paul Tierney and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

52' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Enes Unal (Bournemouth) makes it 2:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Dango Ouattara and planted his close-range header into the top of the net. Bart Verbruggen was helpless.
51' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Bart Verbruggen.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bournemouth.
49' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Bournemouth force a corner. They send men into the box.
47' A brilliant individual effort! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post.
46' Roberto De Zerbi makes a switch. Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is coming on in place of Mark O'Mahony at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Paul Tierney blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' Dangerous play by Igor (Brighton). Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle as Alex Scott (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in his challenge.

45+1' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Bart Verbruggen is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Paul Tierney couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) and blew his whistle.
42' The linesman signals that Enes Unal (Bournemouth) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

40' What a chance that is! Simon Adingra (Brighton) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar!
37' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) commits a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

34' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Bournemouth force their opponents to concede a corner.
32' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
29' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
28' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

27' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Mark Travers thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same. The referee points to the corner flag and Brighton will take a corner.
27' A rebound bounces out to Mark O'Mahony (Brighton) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
26' Rough tackle by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Paul Tierney blows for a foul.
19' Joao Pedro (Brighton) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
16' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
13' 1 - 0 Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the left post, and thus alter the score to 1:0.
12' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

12' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball is out of play and Bournemouth manage to earn a corner.
11' Bournemouth take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
10' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
8' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.

7' Valentin Barco (Brighton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Paul Tierney with no other option than to blow for a foul.
4' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) was too forceful with his tackle and Paul Tierney interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
2' Igor (Brighton) gets on the end of the resulting free kick, but he produces a poor shot which goes well wide of the right post!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Brighton will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Paul Tierney.
